readerCopy.body: The instructions reach the people doing the work before urgency turns into confusion. Tasks are named, responsibilities are divided, and the first action follows the message without another round of approval. Mercury keeps the directions precise, while Mars carries them into motion with speed and confidence. Under the trine, speaking and acting reinforce each other without creating a fight over who has authority. The job moves because nobody has to translate a vague order while the deadline keeps closing in.
